name: Theodore Sikeotes
life: The Monk Theodore Sikeotes (†613) was born in the village of Sikea in Asia Minor. From childhood he was devoted to prayer and asceticism, protected by the Great Martyr George who appeared to him repeatedly. Ordained priest at only 17, he later became Bishop of Anastasiupolis. He was granted the gifts of healing, prophecy, and power over wild animals. He predicted that the military commander Maurice would become emperor, which came to pass. He reposed in 613, venerated as a saint even during his lifetime.
